tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the product catalog. No API key. Each product has a title, a short and a longer description, pictures, a price, an offer when the list has one, and a url for the page where it can be bought. An empty products list means nothing matched. catalog_size 0 means the catalog is still loading.

tools.name: read_product
tools.description: Read one product by the id from search_products. Returns the longer description, the pictures, the price, and the page where it can be bought.
